summary:
Mined all 5 subtitle lineages (11,088 deduped pairs) into a per-term, per-lineage vote table covering 118 terms — every proper noun, creature, hardware and role term requested, plus 12 extras found in-corpus (Prodigy, Neverland, Betty, Narcissus, incinerator, the Company, MU/TH/UR, Engineer, hive/nest/cocoon, marine-loose).

METHOD — extended term_vote.py, did not fork it. mine_terms.py does `import term_vote` and calls its `load()`, so the CnSCG-four-films-fold-to-one-vote and the mirror-file dedup are inherited code, not reimplemented. Verified empirically: 5 lineages, max lineage_count = 5, CnSCG = 4,591 lines from 4 films counted as ONE vote. Every term is English-gated; ranking is lineage_count first, line_count second, exactly as specified.

Three additions over term_vote.py, each forced by a defect I hit:
1. LIFT FILTER. Bare CJK-chunk extraction returns 我们/这个/他们 as "candidates". lift = P(cand|hit-lines)/P(cand|whole-corpus) separates a rendering from ambient vocabulary.
2. LATIN CANDIDATES. LV-426 survives untranslated on the Chinese side as "LV426" — a Han-only regex can never see it. Same for the acronyms.
3. AUDITED PROBE CHANNEL. n-gram mining is unreliable below ~4 hits (it emits clause shards like 我们必须派一艘船). So 96 of 118 terms also carry a hand-curated probe list counted exactly, bypassing all filters. A probe scoring 0 is reported, not dropped — "Romulus never says 汤谷" is itself a finding.

VALIDATION — the miner independently reproduced every known-bad CnSCG rendering listed in the brief without being told them: smartgun→机关枪, science division→卫生署, Ellen→海伦·蕾普丽, stasis→静态平衡, dropship erased ("我们必须派一艘船来救我们"). That is the corpus and the English gate confirming each other.

TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE BRIEF'S OWN NOTES (re-derived from raw lines):
- "APC→焚化炉" is not quite right. The corpus spells it "A.P.C." with periods — `\bAPC\b` returns zero hits, which would have been misread as absence of evidence. What actually happened: 焚化炉 is CnSCG's rendering of *incinerator*, and it bled onto the adjacent A.P.C. line ("fall back by squads to the A.P.C." → "离开焚化炉"). The A.P.C. itself is erased, not mistranslated. CnSCG also renders incinerator correctly as 喷火枪 elsewhere — it has two renderings, one right, one wrong.
- USCM is erased too: "of the Colonial Marine Corps-" → "高曼中尉". A new known-bad for the list.

18 NEW-vs-CnSCG DISAGREEMENTS, all flagged in the JSON with the ruling that priority-2 outranks priority-6. Highest-value ones: pulse rifle Rom24 脉冲步枪 vs CnSCG 电波枪; Science Officer Rom24 科学官 vs CnSCG 科学研究员; Sergeant Earth25/Cov17 中士 vs CnSCG 士官长; Captain Earth25/Cov17 舰长 vs Pro12/CnSCG 船长; airlock four-way split (Rom24 气锁室 / Cov17 空气阀 / Pro12 气闸舱 / CnSCG 空气舱); quarantine 隔离 vs CnSCG 检疫; colonist Rom24 殖民地 vs CnSCG 移民; specimen Earth25 样本 vs CnSCG/Rom24 标本.

22 ZERO-HIT terms flagged unusable. These are not weak evidence, they are no evidence, and the JSON says so per-term.

files_written.what: The deliverable. Top level: meta / terms / zero_hit_unusable / new_lineage_vs_cnscg_disagreements / thin_evidence. Each of the 118 term records carries english_regex, case_sensitive, total_hits, hits_by_lineage, evidence_grade (none|thin|usable), candidates[] (auto-mined: zh, kind, lineage_count, line_count, lineages, per_lineage_lines, corpus_lines, lift, exclusive_to_hits), audited_candidates[] (exact probe counts incl. zeros), audited_zero[], per_lineage_top (with source: audited|auto-mined and coverage as lines/of_hits), per_lineage_top_auto, new_vs_cnscg (status + ruling), and up to 3 bilingual example lines per lineage.

The miner. Imports term_vote and calls term_vote.load(), so lineage folding + dedup are inherited rather than duplicated. Adds lift filtering, Latin-token candidates, maximal-collapse of n-gram shingles, function-word suppression, the audited probe channel, and new-vs-CnSCG comparison. CLI: -o OUT to write the table, --print KEY to dump one term.

The 118 English-gate regexes with category and case-sensitivity, plus the PROBES map of hand-curated Chinese candidates attached to 96 terms. Separate from the miner so terms can be added without touching mining logic.

measurements.value: 11,088 pairs / 5 lineages — CnSCG 4,591 (4 films = 1 vote), AlienEarth2025 2,266, Prometheus2012 1,765, Covenant2017 1,316, Romulus2024 1,150
118 (every term the brief listed, plus 12 in-corpus extras)

measurements.what: Thin evidence (1-3 hits; read the example lines before adopting)

measurements.value: 5 (verified: CnSCG's 4 films fold to a single vote)

decisions.decision: Imported term_vote.load() instead of writing a parallel loader
decisions.reason: The brief forbade losing the lineage folding. Calling the existing function makes that structurally impossible rather than a thing I have to remember to copy correctly.

decisions.decision: Added a lift filter (P(cand|hits)/P(cand|corpus)) on top of the English gate
decisions.reason: The English gate stops bare-Chinese-frequency errors between terms, but within the hit lines every common pronoun still scores highly. Without lift the top candidate for most terms was 我们 or 这个.

decisions.decision: Added Latin-token candidates alongside Han n-grams
decisions.reason: LV-426 appears on the Chinese side as the untranslated string 'LV426'. A Han-only extractor reports zero candidates and the term looks unattested when it is in fact attested five times.

decisions.decision: Added a hand-curated probe channel with exact counts, reported even at 0
decisions.reason: n-gram mining degrades badly below ~4 hits, emitting whole clause shards. Probes give trustworthy counts for thin terms, and an explicit 0 is real evidence — it is how the table shows that Romulus renders Weyland-Yutani as 威兰 and never uses 汤谷 at all.

decisions.decision: per_lineage_top picks the LONGEST probe covering >=50% of that lineage's hits, not the highest count
decisions.reason: A short rendering is always a substring of the long one, so its count can never be lower. Ranking by count alone reported Alien: Earth's Weyland-Yutani as 威兰 when the lineage actually writes 威兰汤谷.

decisions.decision: Suppressed auto-mined fallbacks from per_lineage_top once a term has probes
decisions.reason: Clause shards such as 个口子 and 以阻挡一阵子 were standing in as a lineage's 'preferred rendering' and manufacturing false DISAGREE flags. Where no probe matches, the field is now honestly null.

decisions.decision: Kept both the shorter and longer forms in candidates[] rather than pruning aggressively
decisions.reason: My first pruning rule kept the longer string on ties, which deleted the real term 机关枪 in favour of the shard 拿出机关枪. Shingle collapse is now capped at 6 chars, which folds 焚化/焚化炉/化炉 without letting a clause swallow a term.

decisions.decision: Reported the A.P.C. / 焚化炉 finding as a correction rather than restating the brief
decisions.reason: The brief's note would have led to a permanently zero-hit regex. The distinction matters downstream: APC is erased by CnSCG, whereas incinerator is genuinely mistranslated — different remedies.

open_issues: Five of the 22 zero-hit terms are Alien: Isolation content specifically — Sevastopol, Seegson, Anesidora, Torrens, and Amanda Ripley (whose only film hit is the single line 蕾普丽-麦克伦). Priority level 3, the official Isolation 简中 at AlienRPG/简体汉化/ (768 .TXT, 162,804 keys), almost certainly carries all five with official renderings. That is the obvious next mining target and it outranks CnSCG.

facehugger, chestburster, ovomorph, neomorph and drone all return zero English-gated hits across all five lineages — the films never say these words on screen. They cannot be settled from subtitles at all and need level 1 (the 连载) or level 3 (Isolation).

Nostromo has no good source in this corpus: CnSCG says 诺斯都罗莫号, Romulus 2024 says 诺史莫号, and neither is the mainland-standard 诺斯特罗莫号. The new-beats-old rule alone would install 诺史莫, which reads Taiwan-flavoured. Worth checking against level 1 and level 3 before adopting either.

Romulus 2024 renders Weyland-Yutani as plain 威兰, dropping Yutani entirely (15 of 17 hits), while Alien: Earth writes 威兰汤谷 and uses 汤谷 alone for Yutani. Both are priority-2 lineages and they disagree with each other, so the new-vs-old rule cannot resolve this one — it needs owner adjudication.

Prometheus 2012 and Covenant 2017 use 维兰德 for Weyland where both new lineages use 威兰. This is a level-5-vs-level-2 split rather than a CnSCG conflict, so it is not in the 18 flagged disagreements; the JSON shows it under Weyland (bare) per_lineage_top.
terraforming splits three ways with no CnSCG involvement worth keeping: Rom24 地球化, Cov17 整地, CnSCG 改造. The two priority-2/5 renderings conflict.

Two extras I added, 'the Company' and 'MU/TH/UR (Mother)', use loose gates — `\bthe Company\b` and `\bMother\b` — so the latter conflates MU/TH/UR with ordinary maternal 'mother'. Its 母亲-vs-老妈 disagreement flag should be re-derived with a tighter gate before anyone relies on it.

The lift/probe thresholds in mine_terms.py (lift>=4.0, single-char lift>=25, 6-char collapse cap) were tuned against this corpus by inspection. They are documented inline but are not derived from anything principled, and would need re-checking on a corpus of a different size.
